# Layer `dotnet`

Rules for every .NET repository: C# style, tests, formatting and linting, target frameworks, project files.

Read the files that apply to everything before any task, and the others when you work on the paths they apply to.

| File | Applies to | Topics |
| --- | --- | --- |
| @csharp.instructions.md | `**/*.cs` | C# code: Build constraints, General, Structure, Types and `var`, Language features, Member order, Comments |
| @formatting.instructions.md | everything | Formatting and linting |
| @frameworks.instructions.md | everything | Target frameworks |
| @msbuild.instructions.md | `**/*.csproj`, `**/*.props`, `**/packages.lock.json`, `nuget.config` | Project files and dependencies |
